description:
Activate Varolz by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, regenerating Varolz.
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability by paying {3} and exiling it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
